# Pisum

Pisum is a dark color scheme the description attributes to Gruvbox and Qiita, with visible scrollbars for PC and Linux systems. Its CSS file is thoroughly commented for customization, and a minimal light variant is included.

![Pisum screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/guangluwu/obsidian-pisum/HEAD/fullpower.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Pisum"
    author: "guangluwu"
    repo:   "guangluwu/obsidian-pisum"
    slug:   "pisum"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/pisum"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/guangluwu/obsidian-pisum"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/guangluwu/obsidian-pisum/HEAD/fullpower.png"

    modes: ["dark"]
    about: "Apply a Gruvbox- and Qiita-inspired dark color scheme with visible scrollbars for PC and Linux systems. Provide a thoroughly commented CSS file for easy customization and a minimal light variant."
}
```
